status: PROTOTYPE, UNAUDITED. Nothing is deployed. The owner deploys; never an agent.

notes.contract: stellar/vault (bloch-stellar-vault), built with stellar-cli 30.0.1, soroban-sdk 29.0.1, rustc 1.92.0; the Wasm hash is recorded in docs/STELLAR-BRIDGE-DEPLOY.md and must be reproduced by the owner before the deploy
notes.config: the object under vault.config is the constructor argument of the contract, verbatim; it is immutable once deployed (no setter, no administrator, no upgrade)
notes.units: amounts are in the L2 token's units: 1 USDC = 1e6 units = 1e7 stroops
notes.token: the Stellar Asset Contract of USDC:GA5ZSEJYB37JRC5AVCIA5MOP4RHTM335X2KGX3IHOJAPP5RE34K4KZVN on the public network; the id is computed from the asset and the network passphrase and equals the one Horizon reports (read 2026-11-16)
notes.labels: source_domain = sha256('stellar-pubnet'), native_domain = sha256('bloch-l2-700770'), asset = sha256('USDC')
notes.limits: the Ethereum bridge's launch values, proposed: cap 100,000 USDC (must equal the L2 supplyCap), window 10,000 USDC per 24 h (must equal the L2 bucketCapacity), minDeposit 11 USDC, l2MinBurn 10 USDC
notes.committee: the same keys as the Ethereum vault: the 7 `eth-release-signer` addresses (5 of 7 release and controls, 6 of 7 unpause and the locked re-release) and the 3 `eth-vault-guardian` addresses of docs/BRIDGE-V3-KEY-CEREMONY.md, as 20-byte hex without 0x, each list strictly ascending. No Stellar key holds any power in the vault
notes.releaseDelay: proposed (technical, coordinator to confirm): large_release_threshold 0 and release_delay 7,200 s: every release waits 2 h in the queue, where 2 of 3 guardians can cancel it. release_delay 0 gives exactly the Ethereum launch behaviour (no queue; the bucket is the only bound)
notes.fee: 5 bps of each deposit and 5 bps of each release, fixed. fee_recipient is the owner's Stellar address (owner input 2026-11-16). On 2026-11-16 this account does NOT exist on the public network: it must be created (funded) and given a USDC trustline before the first sweep, see docs/STELLAR-BRIDGE-DEPLOY.md section 2. Until then fees stay accrued in the vault; nothing else depends on it
notes.TBD-owner: the 7 signer addresses, the 3 guardian addresses, the deployer account, confirmation of the limits and of the release delay
